title: next shows no last failure when the failure is held only as a receipt
symptom: On the migrated handoff seed, next says 'Last failure: none' although BUG-0001 holds the failed run as a receipt
trigger: Migrate a project whose failing observation a bug links, or finish the session that held it, then run chough next
expected: next names the latest failed observation by its recorded time, from open entries and from story and bug receipts, with the bugs that link it (REQ-cli-021)
actual: last_failure reads only open sessions' entries, so it is null
steps: Give a bug a failed receipt and no open entries
impact: A fresh agent resuming after a migration or a finished session is not told the last failure
source: t37f's seed.sh capture on the migrated 0.1.0 handoff seed

notes.text: Red on the current next: TC-cli-next-last-failure-from-receipts fails, last_failure is null; revision e7f5b4cc on leif/0.6.0-last-failure-red.
status: open -> verified. Green: TC-cli-next-last-failure-from-receipts passes; next names a failure held only as a bug receipt.
